inv.desc_en:
Attention investors;

Retail sells excellent hospitality premises with an annual profitability of 6% rented to a successful operator. Located in the central business area of Parque Norte and a few meters from Pinar de Chamartín, Arturo Soria street, and Avenida de San Luis. Business district of Madrid with high pedestrian and vehicular traffic.

Characteristics:

- Surface area: 141 m² total on street level.
- Very wide facade of 9 + 12 meters.
- Height: 3 meters.
- Smoke extraction: Yes.
- Hospitality license.
- Outdoor terrace.
- Availability: Immediate.

Key Planning: VIPS, CAIXA BANK, CARREFOUR EXPRESS, THE CIRCULAR MARKET, EL KIOSKO, MAIWAY, SOCCER BAR, FULITO ASIAN KITCHEN, TABERNA LA ESCARCHA, SUPERMERCADOS DÍA, ETC.

We have more premises on the most commercial streets throughout Madrid.

Call us to arrange an investment interview at our offices and we will provide you with more information.

Retail, a leading specialist in commercial premises, business expansion, and investment, with over 2,300 successful operations in our more than 22 years of experience in the real estate market.
